skill.name: Session Drilldown Review
skill.description: Retrieve and inspect a previously recorded agent session, viewing execution timeline, LLM calls, tool invocations, errors, and performance metrics in a unified waterfall visualization.
skill.skill_body:
Open the Session Drawer to find a past session. Load the Session Waterfall view. On the left, examine the time visualization of all LLM calls, Action events, Tool calls, and Errors. On the right, select any event to view its specific details such as exact prompt and completion for LLM calls. Review session metadata including total execution time and SDK versions.

## Objective

inspect_and_analyze_recorded_session
## Applicable Signals

- User has completed an agent run and wants to review it
- Unexpected behavior observed in agent execution
- Performance analysis or optimization needed
- Error investigation required

## Contraindications

- Session has not yet been recorded
- User is setting up initial instrumentation
- No past sessions exist in Session Drawer

## Intervention Moves

- Navigate to Session Drawer
- Select target session from history
- Load Session Waterfall view
- Inspect timeline visualization on left panel
- Click event on waterfall to view details on right panel
- Review LLM call prompts and completions
- Examine action and tool call sequences
- Identify error events and their context

## Workflow Steps

- {'step': 1, 'action': 'Open Session Drawer', 'detail': 'Access the list of all previously recorded sessions'}
- {'step': 2, 'action': 'Select target session', 'detail': 'Choose the session to review from the history list'}
- {'step': 3, 'action': 'Load Session Waterfall', 'detail': 'Open the waterfall visualization showing timeline of all events'}
- {'step': 4, 'action': 'Review left panel timeline', 'detail': 'Examine time visualization of LLM calls, Action events, Tool calls, and Errors'}
- {'step': 5, 'action': 'Select event for details', 'detail': 'Click any event on the waterfall to view specific details on right panel'}
- {'step': 6, 'action': 'Analyze event details', 'detail': 'Review exact prompt, completion, timing, and other metadata for selected event'}

## Constraints

- Session must have been previously recorded with AgentOps instrumentation
- SDK must be on a supported agent framework (Crew, AutoGen, or equivalent)
- Session data must be available in the Session Drawer

## Cautions

- Large sessions with many events may take time to load and render
- Event details are automatically recorded; verify data completeness before analysis

## Output Contract

- Session waterfall view loaded with complete timeline of all LLM calls, actions, tool calls, and errors; selected event details displayed in right panel; session metadata including total execution time and SDK versions visible; user can navigate and inspect any recorded event.
